mcq.s: As per Census 2011, which of the following is the correct sequence in descending order of the number of people speaking these languages as mother tongue? 1. Bengali 2. Marathi 3. Tamil 4. Telugu
mcq.x: Census 2011: Bengali (8.0%) > Marathi (6.9%) > Telugu (6.7%) > Tamil (5.7%). Marathi overtook Telugu in 2011; in 2001 Telugu was third.

mcq.s: As per Census 2011, the percentage of Indians speaking Hindi as their mother tongue is about:
mcq.x: Census 2011 puts Hindi speakers at 43.6% of the population, i.e. about 45%; Bengali is second with about 8%.

mcq.s: Constitutional status has been given to Panchayats under Article:
mcq.x: The 73rd Amendment, 1992 added Part IX 'The Panchayats' (Articles 243 to 243-O) and the Eleventh Schedule, giving Panchayats constitutional status.

mcq.s: The tenure of every Panchayat in India is five years from:
o: The date appointed for its first meeting
The date of notification of election
The date of declaration of election results
The date of oath of office by members
mcq.x: Article 243E: every Panchayat, unless sooner dissolved, continues for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting; if dissolved, fresh elections are held within six months.

mcq.s: Which of the following is NOT among the powers of Panchayati Raj Institutions in India?
mcq.x: Judicial review belongs to the Supreme Court and High Courts; land reforms and poverty alleviation are among the Eleventh Schedule subjects that may be devolved to Panchayats under Article 243G.

mcq.s: Which of the following is NOT true about local governance in India?

One-third of seats in local bodies are reserved for women
The finances of local bodies are reviewed by a State Finance Commission
Elections to local bodies are conducted by a State Election Commission
mcq.x: Local government has its own constitutional provisions: Article 40, Part IX (Panchayats) and Part IXA (Municipalities), added by the 73rd and 74th Amendments, 1992.
